claims.claim: The JPHC study developed logistic models for five-year incident type 2 diabetes prediction and validated them using J-ECOH data.
The RICH Dryad record publicly lists RC Health Care Data-20180820.xlsx and describes a median follow-up of 3.1 years.
Wu and colleagues state that participants lost to follow-up during the three-year window and censored data were excluded from their prediction analysis.
Sasagawa and colleagues compared DeepSurv-based prediction models with Cox proportional hazards models using J-ECOH data.
